# postgresql.conf for PostgreSQL 17 — generated by stroppy.
# Do not edit: regenerate from the cfg.postgresql.conf@17 schema.

# --- Memory ---
shared_buffers = 128MB
huge_pages = try
temp_buffers = 8MB
work_mem = 4MB
hash_mem_multiplier = 2
maintenance_work_mem = 64MB
effective_cache_size = 4096MB

# --- Write-ahead log ---
wal_level = replica
max_wal_size = 1024MB
min_wal_size = 80MB
checkpoint_timeout = 300s
checkpoint_completion_target = 0.9
wal_compression = off
synchronous_commit = on
wal_buffers = -1
fsync = on
full_page_writes = on
wal_writer_delay = 200ms

# --- Replication ---
max_wal_senders = 10
max_replication_slots = 10
hot_standby = on
hot_standby_feedback = off
wal_keep_size = 0MB

# --- Planner ---
seq_page_cost = 1
random_page_cost = 4
effective_io_concurrency = 1
jit = on
default_statistics_target = 100

# --- Autovacuum ---
autovacuum = on
autovacuum_max_workers = 3
autovacuum_naptime = 60s
autovacuum_vacuum_threshold = 50
autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold = 1000
autovacuum_analyze_threshold = 50
autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor = 0.2
autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor = 0.2
autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor = 0.1
autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay = 2ms
autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit = -1
vacuum_cost_delay = 0ms
vacuum_cost_limit = 200
vacuum_cost_page_hit = 1
vacuum_cost_page_miss = 2
vacuum_cost_page_dirty = 20

# --- Connections ---
listen_addresses = '*'
port = 5432
max_connections = 100
superuser_reserved_connections = 3
reserved_connections = 0
ssl = off
tcp_keepalives_idle = 0s
tcp_keepalives_interval = 0s
tcp_keepalives_count = 0

# --- Locks and parallelism ---
max_worker_processes = 8
max_parallel_workers = 8
max_parallel_workers_per_gather = 2
max_parallel_maintenance_workers = 2
max_locks_per_transaction = 64
deadlock_timeout = 1000ms
lock_timeout = 0ms
statement_timeout = 0ms
idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 0ms
transaction_timeout = 0ms

# --- Logging ---
logging_collector = off
log_destination = 'stderr'
log_min_duration_statement = -1
log_checkpoints = on
log_connections = off
log_disconnections = off
log_lock_waits = off
log_temp_files = -1
log_autovacuum_min_duration = 600000
log_line_prefix = '%m [%p] '
log_statement = none

# --- Extensions ---
shared_preload_libraries = 'pg_stat_statements'
pg_stat_statements.max = 5000
pg_stat_statements.track = top

# --- Locale ---
timezone = 'UTC'
lc_messages = 'C'
default_text_search_config = 'pg_catalog.simple'

# server acceptance override
max_connections = 123
